Dear Priya,

Thank you for bringing this to our attention. I understand how frustrating API timeouts must be, especially when it's blocking your users. I sincerely apologize for any disruption this is causing.

I want to assure you that we take this matter seriously. Our team is actively investigating the API timeout issues, and we are committed to resolving this as quickly as possible.

We've already opened a high-priority ticket (ID: T-ext-E_CH_2_001) to track this issue and ensure it receives the urgent attention it deserves.

Please know that we will keep you updated on our progress and work diligently to restore stable API performance for your team.

If you have any additional details about the timeouts (e.g., specific endpoints, frequency, error messages), please share them so we can expedite the resolution.

Thank you for your patience and partnership.

Best regards,
Morgan Lee
